name: MADAR final audit — authenticated release evidence verifier

parameters.content:
## Executable release verifier — inactive, manual only
Target n8n 2.46.7. Configure URLs and fixtureOnly in Configuration. Select a Header Auth credential on the runner request. All requests GET, timeout 5s, at most 2 attempts. Health failure stops release evidence fetch. No shell, build, installation, workflow activation, business writes, or alerts. CI results must come from an authenticated trusted external runner with exact revision + evidence. Default target is an isolated fixture, not MADAR production. See n8n.md.
